tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Latin divus, 'divine', or dies, 'day' — 'heavenly'. Its root is Latin divus / dies. A classical name later used by Christians; borne by Saint Diana. Diana is a Latin name meaning “Divine; heavenly”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
